name: automagik-workspace
description: One Automagik workspace per VM (Debian 13; 2 CPUs, 4GiB, 20GiB). Automagik 3.146.5 server/gate by verified digest; cloudflared 2026.10.7 or Tailscale 1.104.4. Homes and CLI store persist under /data; automagikPnpm pins baked pnpm 10. Give GitHub HTTPS repoUrl, optional repoRef, reach, publicUrl, Access and memberRunner at create. Created stopped: set the reach secret, then instance_start. Arca supplies GITHUB_TOKEN.
